idea-plugin.name: Eskiu
idea-plugin.description: Support for the Eskiu systems programming language (.esk): syntax highlighting from the same TextMate grammar as the VS Code extension, and through the Eskiu language server (LSP4IJ) errors as you type, completion (fields and Type_method functions after x.), hover with types and signatures, signature help, go to definition, the structure view and formatting. The server runs on Node.js and calls eskiuc; set their paths in Settings | Tools | Eskiu when they are not found.

server.name: Eskiu
server.description: The Eskiu language server (eskiuc's editor modes).
